additional_info.subject: RE: AW: 0379657 - ID0379657-DC/Si-D/DE-[Null] Scratch Display CRM:02023000143
additional_info.body:
Dear Maximilian Brosche,
Greetings of the day!
Thank you for providing the serial numbers of the chargers and for our call on MS Teams. As discussed, the PEN bridge was included with the charger at the time of dispatch from the factory. I have attached the picture you shared on MS Teams. There could be several reasons for its absence upon delivery, such as theft or it being misplaced at the site after delivery.
To resolve the PEN bridge issue, you can source a 35 sq. mm PEN bridge cable locally along with copper lugs. You can later claim the cost for this.
If possible, kindly share more pictures of the charger’s display screen to determine if it has scratches. There might be a scratch on the protective film of the display, which is used for protection purposes only. If the protective film has scratches, you may remove it.
If the charger’s display screen itself has scratches, we need details of the transporter. You mentioned that the transportation was within Siemens’ scope. Could you please clarify if it was under Siemens HQ’s scope or the Regional Siemens scope?
Thank you for your cooperation.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
